questions.body-l1: I'd rather pull straight through with power than slowly hunt for footholds
questions.motive-l1: I set clear grade goals and work hard to reach them
questions.mind-l1: I'm willing to try hard moves even if I might fall
questions.body-r1: I spend a lot of time studying where the footholds are and how to stand on them
questions.motive-r1: I climb mainly to enjoy the process and don't care much about grades
questions.mind-r1: I read the whole route before I start climbing
questions.body-l2: I think building strength is more efficient than practicing balance
questions.motive-l2: Sending a project route gives me a huge sense of achievement
questions.mind-l2: I like taking on new routes even when I'm not fully prepared
questions.body-r2: I believe good technique gets you past hard sections better than brute force
questions.motive-r2: I like trying routes in all kinds of styles
questions.mind-r2: I prefer to start on easy routes and gradually raise the difficulty
questions.motive-l3: I drill specific moves over and over to break into a new grade
questions.mind-l3: I think falling is part of climbing and nothing to be afraid of
questions.body-r3: I like using clever body positioning to save energy
questions.motive-r3: I'd rather explore new routes than work the same one repeatedly
questions.mind-r3: I make sure each move is stable before I continue upward
questions.body-l4: I prefer routes with big reaches or jumps
questions.motive-l4: I like tracking my climbing log and my progress over time
questions.mind-l4: On an unfamiliar route I just go for it instead of studying it for a long time
questions.body-r4: I enjoy vertical or thin face routes that demand precise footwork more
questions.motive-r4: I think the best part of climbing is the time spent with friends
questions.mind-r4: I believe thorough preparation matters more than taking risks

PGB.name: Crusher
PGB.tagline: Conquer with power, break through with resolve
PGB.description: You're a natural power climber who meets every challenge head-on. Clear goals keep driving you forward, and a bold mindset lets you commit to moves at your limit. On the wall you're a rock-crushing machine — unstoppable.
strengths: Great physical strength and explosive power
Clear goals and a refusal to give up easily
Not afraid to take on high-difficulty routes
blindSpots: May overlook the importance of technique and rhythm
Prone to injury when overly fixated on a goal
PGB.flowState: Going all out and feeling the conversation between muscle and rock
PGB.clutchState: Throwing everything into one explosive effort at the crux

PGS.name: Forger
PGS.description: You believe strength takes time to forge. Goal-driven, you build long-term training plans and pair them with a steady mindset to accumulate ability step by step. You're in no rush, but every step is solid.
blindSpots: May be too conservative and miss the moment to break through
Plans can be too rigid and lack flexibility
PGS.flowState: Feeling your strength grow within a familiar training rhythm
PGS.clutchState: Relying on long-built ability to move steadily through the hard section

PFB.name: Wildfire
PFB.description: Like a wildfire, you're full of energy and unpredictability. You lean toward powerful climbing but aren't bound by goals, and your bold mindset makes you willing to try any style. You enjoy climbing for its own sake and don't care about scores or grades.
strengths: The courage not to fear failure
blindSpots: Finds it hard to go deep in a single direction
PFB.flowState: Feeling the freedom and power of your body on a new route
PFB.clutchState: Breaking through unknown cruxes on instinct and nerve

PFS.name: Anchor
PFS.tagline: Steady as an anchor, enjoying the journey
PFS.description: You're the steadying force of the climbing world. A powerful body paired with a free-exploring motivation and a steady mindset keeps you stable in any environment. You don't chase quick results; you enjoy the process of every climb.
strengths: Emotionally stable and not easily shaken by pressure
blindSpots: May lack a clear direction for improvement
Too comfortable to step outside the comfort zone
PFS.flowState: Feeling power and calm blend together at a familiar crag
PFS.clutchState: Grinding slowly through the hard section with a steady mind and body

TGB.name: Sniper
TGB.description: You're the sniper among technical climbers. Clear goals keep you focused on sending specific routes, and a bold mindset lets you attempt moves at your limit. What you pursue is completing the hardest challenges with the most precise technique.
blindSpots: May lack patience for routes that are not the project
Chasing efficiency at the expense of the experience
TGB.flowState: Feeling the thrill of precision in perfectly executed technique
TGB.clutchState: Reading the moves precisely and passing the crux in one go

TGS.name: Cipher
TGS.description: You analyze every route like a cryptographer. A technical climbing style combined with goal-driven motivation and a steady mindset makes you good at breaking problems down, forming a strategy, and then systematically overcoming the challenge.
TGS.flowState: Entering flow while decoding the puzzle of a route
TGS.clutchState: Finding the best solution through calm analysis

TFB.name: Wanderer
TFB.tagline: Roaming everywhere with technique as a companion
TFB.description: You're the nomad of the climbing world. Refined technique lets you adapt to every rock type and style, a free-exploring motivation sends you to crags everywhere, and a bold mindset makes you fearless of the unknown. Every wall is a new adventure.
strengths: Highly adaptable, able to climb any rock type
blindSpots: Hard to reach the very top in a single discipline
TFB.flowState: Discovering the conversation between body and rock at a brand-new crag
TFB.clutchState: Improvising through unknown cruxes with a wealth of experience

TFS.name: Zen
TFS.tagline: Climb with a quiet mind, at one with the rock
TFS.description: You're the practitioner of the climbing world. With a technical climbing style, a free-exploring motivation and a steady mindset, what you seek is not grades or results but the state of mind and body becoming one as you climb.
strengths: A deep sensitivity to the experience of climbing
blindSpots: May lack the drive to push through limits
Less interested in the competitive side
TFS.flowState: Feeling breath, movement and rock become one while climbing
TFS.clutchState: Finding inner stability through deep breathing and focus
